title: boraginella stricta
intro: Boraginella stricta, commonly known as the 'Indian Apple', is a perennial plant that belongs to the Boraginaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Boraginella stricta include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate respiratory problems, and exhibit antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
